characterList.description: A man holding a pen in his right hand. We can see the hand and his wedding ring. For a moment we see his left hand on the table. In a certain moment he has a bandage in one of his fingers. He is wearing a dark blue sweater.
characterList.name: Mr. A

content_metadata.description: A comprehensive guide by Mr. A on understanding geometric transformations including translation, reflection, and rotation using graph paper and simple tools.

qAndA.question: What instruction is written on the top right corner of the first graph paper?
How many times is the ruler used in the video?

qAndA.answer: Because it is difficult to keep the tracing paper still on top of the graph to mark the points precisely.
qAndA.question: Why does the user prefer to write the coordinates of the points in the tracing paper instead of drawing the dots directly on the graph?

qAndA.answer: Using capital letters and adding apostrophes to the letter to indicate how many times that point has been transformed (A' for the first time, A'' for the second time and so on)
qAndA.question: How is the user labeling the points?
How many different methods are explained for rotations?

activities.description: Marking dots on a graph paper following an instruction
Joining the dots using a ruler

scenes.contextualRelevance: The video is focused on explaining mathematical concepts.

narrativeProgression.description: Mr A welcomes the audience to his Extra Help videos and introduces the topic of the day: transformations.
Mr A explains the concept of translation.
Mr A joins the points marked on the graph paper to form a new polygon as the result of the translation.

scenes.title: Introduction and Translation

videoEditingDetails.description: No sound at the beginning of the video

activities.description: Drawing a line on a graph paper as the line of reflexion
Marking dots on a graph paper as the reflexion of the polygon following the line drawn
Joining the dots using a ruler

scenes.contextualRelevance: The video is focused on explaining mathematical concepts.

narrativeProgression.description: Mr A draws a line that will work as the line of reflection.
Mr A marks the reflection points of the polygon on the graph paper.
Mr A joins the points marked on the graph paper to form a new polygon as the result of the reflection.

scenes.title: Reflection

activities.description: Marking a dot on a graph paper that will work as a pivot point for the rotation
Using a piece of paper with the polygon drawn on it and rotating it around the pivot point
Writing the coordinates of the rotated polygon on the paper
Marking the dots on the graph paper based on the coordinates from the paper
Drawing a cross shape on the graph paper
Rotating the polygon based on the cross shape
Marking dots on a graph paper as the rotation of the polygon following the cross shape
Joining the dots using a ruler

scenes.contextualRelevance: The video is focused on explaining mathematical concepts.

narrativeProgression.description: Mr A introduces the concept of rotation.
Mr A marks a point on the graph paper that will work as a pivot point for the rotation.
Mr A places a piece of paper with the polygon drawn on it on top of the graph paper and rotates it around the pivot point to visually show the rotation.
Mr A writes the new coordinates of the rotated polygon on the paper.
Mr A marks the dots on the graph paper based on the coordinates from the paper.
Mr A draws a cross shape centered on the pivot point.
Mr A uses the cross shape to visually explain how to rotate the polygon 90 degrees clockwise.
Mr A joins the dots on the graph paper to form the rotated polygon.

scenes.title: Rotation

content_metadata.title: Exploring Geometric Transformations with Mr. A
